hash_prefix.description: The first 5 hex digits of the hash, in upper case. Only they are sent to Have I Been Pwned.

breach_count.description: Times the password was seen in breach data. It does not count breaches. 0 when not found.

summary.description: One sentence that states breach_count in words.

charged.description: Credits this call cost; 0 for a free tool.

remaining.description: Credits left in the budget window. Absent when not paid from a credit budget.
